caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn carriage with two main views: a perspective side view and a front elevation view. The carriage features a wooden body in a brown color with curved, elegant lines and a single seat. It is supported by four large, spoked wheels that are colored in a pale green shade. A long, thin, yellow shaft extends from the front for attachment to a horse. The carriage is covered by a black or dark grey canopy that arches over the seat and is held up by slender metal supports. The interior of the carriage appears to be upholstered in a darker brown or burgundy material. The front elevation view shows the alignment and shape of the canopy, the front seat, and the wheels from a head-on viewpoint. The drawing is rendered on a cream-colored background, with some signs of aging, and is signed at the lower right corner by Francis Lam Durand. The technical front view is outlined inside a rectangular box with labels and a scale, while the side perspective view occupies the lower left quadrant of the page.
title: Toy Wagon
